notes.title: Slamoids! Update
notes.notes:
Slamoids Hotfix: 

- Addressed a bug that would cause the link to Star-Pit Starship to activate during gameplay. 

We really appreciate the feedback we've been getting on the game so far. We consider all player input when updating the game, so please don't hesitate to let us know if there's a change you'd like to see made to the game. Feel free to contact us at devs@puddledockgames.com if you'd like to get in touch. Thanks!

notes.title: Slamoids! Release Details
notes.notes:
Thanks for checking out Slamoids! 

The game will be priced at $0.99, and will launch with a 15% discount for the first week.
